_about: The player's squad (lane A5): allied Juggernauts, one entry each, spawned beside the player by "order" up to Settings gameplay.squad_size. Each is a full physics Juggernaut (MechBuilder, the same legs, drive and gun as the player's) driven by a SquadPilot (scripts/ai/squad_pilot.gd) that only moves the same sticks and triggers a pilot's hands would. Entry: callsign and pilot (what the Handler view shows), mech (a data/mechs.json id: the variant / loadout), slot [x right, y, z back] in metres from the leader in follow formation (the first two a little ahead on the flanks, so the third-person camera sees them), engage_m (how far it opens fire with the 57 mm; overrides pilot.engage_m), colour (its marker in the Handler view). "pilot" holds the shared pilot figures.
